repo_notes.author: k7d maintainers
repo_notes.content: k7d is a Rust microVM runtime (VMM + containerd shim + guest agent) for forking live Kubernetes environments in ~100ms. Architecture: long-running k7d daemon owns KVM VMs, vsock, virtio devices, and cluster bridges; containerd-shim-k7-v1 is a thin client over /run/k7d/k7d.sock; guest k7-agent speaks JSON over vsock. Start with README.md and docs/architecture.md, then docs/concepts.md (CoW memory, zero-restart networking, snapshot tree). Latency claims are CI-enforced via crates/k7d/src/latency.rs + LATENCY_BUDGETS.md. Debugging war stories live in CHALLENGES.md. Formal methods: Kani harnesses beside unsafe code; Aeneas→Lean proofs for crates/k7d/src/tree_model.rs under verif/. Sibling project Katakate/k7 orchestrates sandboxes with Python SDKs.

pages.title: Architecture overview
pages.purpose: Explain the daemon/shim/agent split, control socket, and how a kubectl pod with runtimeClassName k7 becomes a microVM. Anchor on docs/architecture.md and docs/concepts.md.

pages.title: Crate map
pages.purpose: Map crates/k7d (VMM library + daemon), crates/shim (containerd shim v2), crates/agent (guest agent), crates/replicate. Point readers to docs/file-map.md for per-file orientation.

pages.title: Fork and snapshot engine
pages.purpose: Document warm fork, dirty-bitmap CoW memory, virtio-blk/erofs rootfs, cluster fork (shared L2 lie on a fresh bridge), and the snapshot tree API (tree_create, tree_fork_batch, protect/prune/auto_evict). Code anchors: fork.rs, snapshot.rs, tree.rs, tree_model.rs, network.rs.

pages.title: containerd / k3s integration
pages.purpose: Document RuntimeClass k7 registration, pod_annotations for k7d.katakate.org/*, why BinaryName must not be set, multi-container pods, and multi-vCPU sizing from pod CPU limits. Anchors: crates/shim/src/task.rs, packaging/install.sh, HACKING.md.

pages.title: Formal verification
pages.purpose: Describe Kani proofs on unsafe/arithmetic paths and Aeneas→Lean verification of the tree budget model (verif/), plus the axiom allowlist gate (utils/check-verif-axioms.sh).

pages.title: Build, release, and latency budgets
pages.purpose: Cover Makefile targets (build, release tarball, remote-check), guest kernel/initramfs packaging, install.sh, and the CI-enforced LATENCY_BUDGETS.md numbers with the benchmark write-up under docs/blog/.

pages.title: Engineering challenges
pages.purpose: Summarize the highest-signal entries in CHALLENGES.md (device dirty pages, timer restore, zero-restart networking) as the reliability narrative behind the fork claims.
